purpose: Verify whether official Taiwan MOEA machine-readable industrial production/sales/inventory sources are fresh, aligned, and granular enough for D10 physical-cycle research before any alpha test.
sourceNotes: Official Government Open Data pages expose downloadable CSV resources hosted at service.moea.gov.tw/EE520/opendata.
Current web text fetch could not parse application/octet-stream directly, but alternate read-only fetch successfully read the CSV bytes/text.
Dataset-level freshness differs materially by metric; never assume one source family shares one latest observation month.

alignedBroadGroupPilot.reason: Production and inventory-ratio resources are current into 2026, but the tested four-group sales-volume resource stops at 11203, so a 2026 aligned physical-cycle state would mix vintages.
alignedBroadGroupPilot.rule: Do not combine series unless latest observation months and knownAt clocks are compatible.

electronicComponentsSourceOnlySnapshot.interpretation: Production and sales values are strongly higher YoY while inventory value and inventory ratio rise even faster. This is intentionally not assigned a bullish/bearish sign. Pricing, margin, capacity, product mix and subsequent inventory absorption are required.

mandatoryGates: SOURCE_FRESHNESS_GATE: latestObservationMonth must meet expected release cadence; stale series become UNKNOWN.
SERIES_ALIGNMENT_GATE: do not combine metrics from materially different observation vintages.
SERIES_GRANULARITY_GATE: the required industry code must exist in the source; do not substitute a broad parent after seeing outcomes.
VINTAGE_CAPTURE_GATE: store fetchedAt, source URL/dataset id, raw-byte hash where possible, parser version and revisions prospectively.
NO_FORWARD_FILL_GATE: later observations or revised files must never be backfilled before their knownAt.
NO_ALPHA_BEFORE_SOURCE_READY: source-only pilot cannot be used to infer future stock returns.
next: Identify a current machine-readable sales/inventory lane for at least one non-tech industry or formally retain SOURCE_GAP.
Audit whether the MOEA interactive database exposes a supported downloadable/query contract for detailed 4-digit codes such as 2611/2613/2630 without brittle UI scraping.
Start prospective vintage capture only after dataset-specific freshness checks pass.
